Description: Power-on Reset & Entry Vector Check: Reset de-assertion allows VeeR-EL2 to fetch its first instruction from address 0x0000_0000 (_start) into ICCM.
Checkpoint: CPU executes first opcode at reset vector. Reset values asserted across all peripheral registers.
C verification part: Execute entry bootstrap in crt0.S, configure gp, initialize stack pointer (sp = __stack_top), zero out .bss, and write 0x00000001 to GPIO_OUT (0x4000_2180) to signal boot start.
SV verification part: Drive active-low reset sys_rst_n = 0 for 20 cycles, deassert, and monitor CPU reset vector execution. Verify all 6 interconnect slave buses and peripheral registers remain quiescent in default reset states.

Description: DCCM Stack Frame & Memory Integrity: Verify byte, half-word, and word reads and writes to local DCCM memory (0xF004_0000) without generating bus traps.
Checkpoint: Push/pop stack memory returns expected data without bus-error trap or exception flags.
C verification part: Allocate stack frames across nested function calls (test_uart(), test_timer(), etc.). Push/pop caller/callee registers. Write and verify walking 1s/0s patterns.
SV verification part: Snoop CPU LSU bus and DCCM interface signals. Assert zero memory bus error flags and confirm CPU exception lines remain deasserted (1'b0).

Description: UART Configuration & Baud Setup: Verify UART Line Control Register (UART_LCR), Baud Divisor (UART_BAUD_DIV), and Interrupt Enable (UART_IER) readback.
Checkpoint: Registers accept configuration and retain values under standard AXI4-Lite access.
C verification part: Set DLAB=1 in UART_LCR (0x4000_000C), write divisor 40 to UART_BAUD_DIV (0x4000_0008), set 8N1 format in UART_LCR (0x03), and enable RX IRQ in UART_IER (0x4000_0004 = 0x01). Assert readback matches.
SV verification part: UVM AXI Master Monitor passively snoops Interconnect Slave Port M00 (0x4000_0000). Checks awready/wready handshakes, verifies bresp === 2'b00 (OKAY), and scoreboard checks register reflection.

Description: UART Transmitter Character Serialization: Transmit ASCII byte 'A' (0x41) across serial pin uart_tx_o at configured baud rate (divisor = 40 clock ticks).
Checkpoint: Serial pin uart_tx_o outputs frame matching 8N1 timing and data 0x41.
C verification part: Poll UART_LSR until THRE (bit 5) is set, then write 0x41 ('A') to UART_THR (0x4000_0000). Poll UART_LSR until TEMT (bit 6) confirms empty transmitter shift register.
SV verification part: uart_agent monitor detects falling edge (start bit) on uart_tx_o, samples 8 bits sequentially mid-cycle at 40-cycle bit periods, and checks stop bit. Flags UVM_ERROR if captured data != 8'h41.

Description: UART Receiver Data Injection & Interrupt: External host injects byte 0x5A into uart_rx_i and verifies reception in Receiver Buffer Register (UART_RBR).
Checkpoint: UART_RBR reads 0x5A and uart_interrupt_o asserts on byte arrival.
C verification part: Wait in polling loop checking UART_LSR[0] (Data Ready). Read UART_RBR (0x4000_0000) and verify data == 0x5A. Verify interrupt deasserts upon CPU reading UART_RBR.
SV verification part: uart_agent driver serializes byte 8'h5A with start/stop bits into uart_rx_i. Monitor asserts uart_interrupt_o === 1'b1 upon complete word framing and checks deassertion after CPU read.

Description: UART FIFO / Multi-Byte Burst Transmission: Stream multi-byte string 'RISCV' sequentially across interconnect and verify serial output.
Checkpoint: All 5 ASCII characters are transmitted in order without FIFO corruption or loss.
C verification part: Loop through string 'RISCV', writing each character into UART_THR while monitoring UART_LSR[5]. Emit step code to GPIO_OUT.
SV verification part: UVM scoreboard collects stream of 5 serial frames from uart_tx_o. Checks exact payload sequence {'R', 'I', 'S', 'C', 'V'} and asserts zero frame or parity errors.

Description: 64-bit Timer Prescaler & Counter Progression: Program 12-bit prescaler and 8-bit step, enable timer active bit, and check 64-bit counter progression.
Checkpoint: TIMER_V_LOWER0 increments monotonically at programmed step rate.
C verification part: Write 0x0001_0000 (Step=1, Prescaler=0) to TIMER_CFG0 (0x4000_410C), and write 0x1 to TIMER_CTRL (0x4000_4004). Sample t0 = TIMER_V_LOWER0, wait 20 cycles, sample t1, and assert t1 >= t0 + 15.
SV verification part: Snoop Port M01. Verify TIMER_CTRL write takes effect
column8: and 64-bit mtime counter advances monotonically on sys_clk cycles.

Description: Timer Compare Match Interrupt Generation & W1C: Program 64-bit compare threshold (TIMER_COMPARE_LOWER0/UPPER0) and verify interrupt on threshold match.
Checkpoint: timer_interrupt_o asserts when mtime >= mtimecmp and deasserts on W1C.
C verification part: Read TIMER_V_LOWER0, write compare target (cur_time + 25) to TIMER_COMPARE_LOWER0 (0x4000_4118), unmask TIMER_INTR_ENABLE0 = 1, wait for match, and clear with W1C (TIMER_INTR_STATE0 = 1).
SV verification part: Monitor timer_interrupt_o pin. Assert that timer_interrupt_o transitions 0 -> 1 exactly when counter matches threshold, and deasserts to 0 immediately upon W1C write completion.

Description: Timer Software Forced Interrupt Test: Force timer interrupt via TIMER_INTR_TEST0 and verify pending flag and IRQ pin assertion.
Checkpoint: Software force triggers interrupt without compare match; clears via W1C.
C verification part: Write 0x1 to TIMER_INTR_TEST0 (0x4000_4108). Read TIMER_INTR_STATE0 and assert bit 0 is set. Write 0x1 to TIMER_INTR_STATE0 to clear.
SV verification part: Assert timer_interrupt_o === 1'b1 upon TIMER_INTR_TEST0 write. Scoreboard checks that timer counter value is unaffected by the forced test event.

Description: GPIO Pin Direction & Output Drive: Configure Pin 0 as Push-Pull Output and drive direct HIGH and LOW states.
Checkpoint: External pin gpio_io[0] reflects programmed register states directly.
C verification part: Read GPIO_INFO (0x4000_2000) and assert version 2 and 32 pins (0x0000_0820). Program GPIO_MODE_0 (0x4000_2008) = 0x01 (Push-Pull Output). Write GPIO_OUT (0x4000_2180) = 0x1 then 0x0.
SV verification part: gpio_agent monitor samples bidirectional port gpio_io[0]. Checks that gpio_io[0] transitions cleanly 0 -> 1 and 1 -> 0 matching GPIO_OUT writes.

Description: GPIO Atomic Bit Manipulation (SET / CLEAR / TOGGLE): Verify atomic register writes modify only target bit without reading/modifying entire port.
Checkpoint: Target pin state changes atomically without affecting adjacent pins.
C verification part: Write 0x1 to GPIO_CLEAR (0x4000_2280) -> verify OUT[0]==0. Write 0x1 to GPIO_SET (0x4000_2200) -> verify OUT[0]==1. Write 0x1 to GPIO_TOGGLE (0x4000_2300) -> verify OUT[0]==0.
SV verification part: Scoreboard checks atomic register decoder in gpio_reg_top. Asserts that atomic operations take effect in exactly 1 clock cycle and adjacent bits gpio_io[31:1] remain untouched.

Description: GPIO Synchronized External Input Sampling: Drive external stimulus on Pin 1 and verify CPU samples values through 2-stage synchronizers.
Checkpoint: GPIO_IN returns injected pattern after 2-clock synchronization delay.
C verification part: Configure Pin 1 as input (MODE_0[3:2] = 00), enable input sampling in GPIO_EN (0x4000_2080 = 0x02). Read GPIO_IN (0x4000_2100) and compare read data against injected pattern.
SV verification part: gpio_agent driver drives stimulus onto gpio_io[1]. Verify signal passes through gpio_input_stage 2-flip-flop synchronizer and asserts stable read response on Port M02 within 2-3 clock cycles.

Description: GPIO Edge-Triggered Interrupt & W1C Servicing: Configure rising-edge trigger on Pin 1 and verify interrupt generation on low-to-high transition.
Checkpoint: gpio_interrupt_o triggers on 0->1 transition and clears on W1C write.
C verification part: Enable sticky interrupt mode via GPIO_CFG (0x4000_2004), set GPIO_INTRPT_RISE_EN (0x4000_2380) = 0x02. Detect interrupt, read GPIO_INTRPT_STATUS (0x4000_2580), and clear via W1C (write 0x02).
SV verification part: Wait for testbench driver to pulse gpio_io[1] 0 -> 1. Assert gpio_interrupt_o === 1'b1 and GPIO_INTRPT_STATUS[1] === 1'b1. Verify deassertion after CPU W1C write.

Description: SPI Clock Ratio & Master Control Setup: Configure SPI Clock Ratio (SPI_RCLK) and Master Enable in Control Register (SPI_CR).
Checkpoint: Registers retain configuration; SPI status register reports FIFOs empty (0x05).
C verification part: Read SPI_SR (0x4000_6064) and assert status == 0x05 (TX/RX FIFO empty). Write 0x186 to SPI_CR (0x4000_6060) to enable Master Mode and SPI system. Assert readback matches.
SV verification part: UVM AXI monitor checks Port M03 transactions. Asserts SPI core enters Master state and internal baud counter initializes according to SPI_RCLK.

Description: SPI Byte Transmission & Serial Clock Activation: Write byte 0xA5 to SPI_DTR and observe serial transmission across MOSI and SCK.
Checkpoint: spi_clk_o toggles 8 clock pulses; spi_mosi_o outputs 0xA5 MSB-first.
C verification part: Write 0xA5 to SPI_DTR (0x4000_6068). Poll SPI_SR until TX FIFO empty flag asserts and transfer complete flag indicates idle. Emit step code to GPIO.
SV verification part: spi_agent monitor samples spi_cs_n_o going active LOW, counts exactly 8 cycles of spi_clk_o, and samples spi_mosi_o on active clock edge. Checks captured byte == 8'hA5.

Description: I2C Clock Prescaler & Core Enable Setup: Program prescaler registers (I2C_PRER_LO/HI) and activate core enable bit in Control Register (I2C_CTR).
Checkpoint: I2C core initializes; SCL and SDA lines stay pulled HIGH by open-drain buffers.
C verification part: Read default prescaler (0xFF), write 0x64 (100) to I2C_PRER_LO (0x4000_8000), read back to verify. Write 0x80 to I2C_CTR (0x4000_8008) to enable I2C controller.
SV verification part: Monitor Port M04 AXI transactions. Verify i2c_scl_io and i2c_sda_io maintain pull-up HIGH states and internal prescaler begins dividing sys_clk.

Description: PWM 8-bit Duty Cycle Modulation: Program 50% duty cycle (0x80) and 100% duty cycle (0xFF) into PWM_DUTY_REG (0x4000_A000).
Checkpoint: pwm_out_o generates square wave with exact programmed high/low pulse ratios.

Description: PWM Dynamic Range & Continuous Rollover: Sweep duty cycle from 0% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% and verify smooth counter wrap-around.

Description: DMA CSR Register Access & Hardware Version: Verify dedicated AXI4-Lite CSR slave port (0x4000_C000) read/write and version signature.
Checkpoint: DMA_STATUS returns version 0xCAFE; control registers read/write correctly.
C verification part: Read DMA_STATUS (0x4000_C008) and assert bits [15:0] == 0xCAFE. Write and readback test descriptors (DMA_DESC0_SRC, DMA_DESC0_DST, DMA_DESC0_LEN, DMA_DESC0_CFG).
SV verification part: UVM AXI-Lite monitor snoops dedicated dma_csr_* bus. Verifies OKAY responses and asserts hardware version 16'hCAFE.

Description: DMA Autonomous Burst Transfer via Interconnect S01: DMA transfers 4-byte word autonomously from PWM (0x4000_A000) to GPIO_OUT (0x4000_2180).
Checkpoint: GPIO_OUT receives transferred data 0x1234_5678; dma_done_interrupt_o asserts; CPU is not loaded.
C verification part: Write 0x1234_5678 to PWM_DUTY_REG, clear GPIO_OUT = 0. Program DMA descriptor (SRC=PWM, DST=GPIO_OUT, LEN=4, CFG=0x7). Set DMA_CONTROL GO bit. Wait for dma_done. Verify GPIO_OUT == 0x1234_5678.
SV verification part: UVM bus monitor captures autonomous AXI4 master transactions on Interconnect Port S01 (s01_axi_*). Asserts correct address arbitration, read from M05, write to M02, and dma_done_interrupt_o === 1'b1.
